problem: Reusing an EntityBuilder that had already committed an unlocked addition, then attempting a locked edit, could clear the same builder journal referenced by the previous undo entry.
change: EntityBuilder retains its last applied journal. It prepares restoration before processing, restores that journal on a locked-layer refusal, and prepares the next journal before changing the document.
validation: A focused regression commits an unlocked addition, reuses the same builder for a refused locked edit, then verifies that one undo removes the earlier addition and redo restores it while the locked object remains unchanged.
A macOS ARM64 fast compatibility run passed 173 tests spanning entity/compound builders, layers, selection, canvas, DXF export/roundtrip, DWG import and Lua/Python scripting.
limits: The control covers one direct builder reuse profile; complex repeated operation stacks and mixed compound Builder atomicity remain open.
Low-level storage mutation, native consumers and platform qualification remain open; no support claim or fixture was added.
